message.content:
I don’t have access to live clocks, so I can’t give you the exact current time right now.  
If you need the precise time in New York City, you can:

1. **Check your phone or computer** – most devices display the local time for your current location or allow you to add a city clock.  
2. **Use an online world‑clock** – sites like timeanddate.com or the built‑in “World Clock” feature on many browsers will show the current time in New York (Eastern Time, UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time).  
3. **Ask a smart assistant** – say “What time is it in New York?” to Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa, etc.

If you’d like, I can explain how to set up a world‑clock widget or give you a quick link to a reliable online source.
